body: U20 shipped on branch cursor/u20-damage-in-real-time-c592 (not master — triage that branch). Research only: research/U20_DAMAGE_IN_REAL_TIME.md + U20_DIGEST.md. Finding: keep the six regions and the round panel; replace the 14s lump with impacts (t_s, region, force 0-1, contact). Two channels — wear on live body_condition (conservation-split so R80's ~1.8 lands do not 4x the bout); shock is a rare per-impact roll on a clean head shot (flash KD = recovered). Hurt/KD thresholds of 18/20 die with the lump. No healing, no eighth stat, no tick in the formula. Please write the HANDOFF block.
